critical_code_review_comments: EvaluationCharts.smartDomain edge case: with 1 point (evals.length===1) span=0 → desiredSpan = max(0, minSpan, 1). Result works (v ± minSpan/2). Verified logically — no crash. Non-blocking.

rca of the issue: Original bug: drawFooter looped over doc.getNumberOfPages() but computed pageH = doc.internal.pageSize.getHeight() BEFORE the loop, so when the doc mixed portrait (page1,2) with landscape (page3), pageH stayed fixed at whichever orientation was current on the doc at that moment, causing 'Desde 1930' to render at the wrong Y (looked overlapping mid-page on some pages). Fix: move pageH (and pageW) computation INSIDE the for-loop, AFTER doc.setPage(i), so each page's actual dimensions are used. Verified via pymupdf: portrait footer at y=826/842 = 98% down, landscape footer at y=580/595 = 97% down — both correct.
